description: The components a vendor bundles with a release of its product (cveFeed.bundled_components): the Tomcat in an Atlassian installer, the Lucene and Log4j of an Elasticsearch release, the Jetty in jenkins.war, the nginx, Redis and Ruby of the Omnibus GitLab package, the Quarkus of Keycloak, the Go of a Grafana build. An entry is an INFERENCE: the host runs that component only if the owner kept the bundled one. A reading made from this table is never "exact": it is "inferred", and never puts a version inside an affected range on its own. Every entry was read from the vendor's own published page or the release tag's build file, cited in "source" ({version} is the product release, {via} the intermediate component). Add an entry only from such a source.

products.note: the Tomcat the Linux and Windows installers and the archive bundle (the application runs in it)

products.label: Apache Lucene
products.note: the Lucene every Elasticsearch release is built on (lucene in the release tag's build file)

products.label: Apache Log4j
products.note: the Log4j 2 every Elasticsearch release ships (log4j in the release tag's build file); a later Elastic patch release or a replaced jar changes it

products.label: Eclipse Jetty
products.note: the Jetty inside the Winstone launcher of jenkins.war (java -jar jenkins.war, the Linux packages and the official image run it; a war deployed into another servlet container does not)

products.label: nginx
products.note: the nginx the Omnibus GitLab package and the official image embed (/opt/gitlab/embedded); a source install or an external nginx runs another

products.label: Redis
products.note: the Redis the Omnibus GitLab package and the official image embed (/opt/gitlab/embedded); a source install or an external Redis runs another

products.label: Ruby
products.note: the Ruby the Omnibus GitLab package and the official image embed (/opt/gitlab/embedded); a source install or an external Ruby runs another

products.label: Quarkus
products.note: the Quarkus every Keycloak distribution since 17 is built on (quarkus.version in the release tag's pom)

products.label: Go
products.note: the Go release Grafana's release build used (the Dockerfile's GO_IMAGE and the release pipeline's golang_version at the tag, kept only where the two agree)
